A trademark of the [[Belascan]] people, the '''Belascan headdress''' was made of wrapped jeweled cloth. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Uta S'orn]] wore this headdress during a meeting with [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]].
